summary: Sun Life Financial filed a Form 6-K on August 14, 2026, announcing it will not redeem its Series 10R and Series 11QR preferred shares on September 30, 2026, triggering a one-for-one conversion privilege between the two series. Holders may convert until September 16, 2026, with automatic conversion if fewer than one million shares of a series remain. New dividend rates will be set August 31, 2026. Redemption terms remain at $25.00 or $25.50 per share. This is a routine preferred-share conversion notice, not a special situation. What to watch: holder conversion elections and any regulatory approval for future redemptions.
